altJa: 淡い背景に、青みのある丸いブルーベリーを五粒描いたイラスト。手前の二粒には、星形にくぼんだ部分が見えます。
observationJa: 一粒ずつの丸い輪郭と、向きによって見えるくぼみを比べます。色だけに頼らず、果実の形や表面の見え方も観察します。
limitJa: 一般的な外観を描いた一例です。色や形には違いがあるため、この図だけで品種、熟度、品質、病害の有無や食べられるかどうかは判定しません。実物の大きさを示す図でもありません。

generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original common-appearance fruit illustration for an adult Japanese agriculture learning app. Create a small loose group of FIVE whole blueberries, uncut, blue-black to muted deep blue with subtle pale waxy bloom. Each berry has a rounded slightly flattened spherical form; show the small recessed star-shaped blossom-end crown clearly on two front-facing berries, while the others face different directions with natural variation. The crown is a small dry recessed feature, not a protruding green leaf star. Arrange the five berries in a new irregular shallow arc with minimal overlap, each contour readable and the complete group inside comfortable margins. Do not arrange as a hanging grape bunch or add connecting grape stalks. Gentle refined botanical 2D painted illustration, restrained soft matte shading and natural outlines, uniform warm ivory background matching calm educational vegetable and fruit illustrations. No source/reference images supplied, no textbook photo or page reproduction. No cut fruit, seeds, exposed flesh, leaves, branches, bowl, plate, packaging, people, text, labels, numbers, arrows, logo, border or watermark. One common-appearance example only: no cultivar, exact-size, ripeness, edibility, quality, disease or universal-color claim.
